Flood Tide Allandra Grey is the Flood Tide of the Water Queen's House temple in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
“
You have done the Bitch Queen's house a great deed - I pray that when you die, your lungs are blessed with her salted kisses.
„
— Allandra Grey, after the completion of Avenge the Drowned

Involvement

Act 3

As the party approach the Water Queen's House, they hear a chorus of singing coming from within. Allandra and her priestesses are holding a funeral for the fallen  Holli Dylford, who was blessed with the "divine mercy" of drowning.

After Allandra acknowledges the parties presence, she asks for an offering for the deceased. She appreciates any tribute given, though certain classes have special options:

  • I've brought gold
  • I've brought a prayer.
  • I've brought my weapon to help avenge her death.
  • [CLERIC] I will pray to my god for her salvation.
  • [CLERIC OF BAHAMUT] I will pray that the Platinum Dragon's shining light guides her spirit.
  • [CLERIC OF CORELLON LARETHIAN] I will pray to the Elffather for her.
  • [CLERIC OF EILISTRAEE] I will pray that Eilistraee guides her final dance.
  • [CLERIC OF GARL GLITTERGOLD] I will pray that Garl Glittergold protects her soul in death.
  • [CLERIC OF GRUUMSH] I will pray that Gruumsh grants her vengeance eternal.
  • [CLERIC OF HELM] I will entreat Helm to keep her in his watchful gaze.
  • [CLERIC OF ILMATER] She will suffer no more in death - the Rack-Broken Lord will ensure that.
  • [CLERIC OF KELEMVOR] The Lord of the Dead will smooth her soul's passage - I will ensure it.
  • [CLERIC OF LADUGUER] I will ask for Laduguer's aid in her passing.
  • [CLERIC OF LATHANDER] My prayers will grant her the Morninglord's shining light.
  • [CLERIC OF LOLTH] The Queen of the Dark Seldarine will see her soul safely to the afterlife.
  • [CLERIC OF MIELIKKI] I will ask the Forest Queen to find a safe path for her soul.
  • [CLERIC OF MORADIN] I will pray for her in the Dwarffather's name.
  • [CLERIC OF MYSTRA] I will ensure the Weavemistress watches over her soul.
  • [CLERIC OF OGHMA] I will pray that her soul holds Oghma's wisdom in death.
  • [CLERIC OF SELÛNE] A simple prayer - that the Silver Lady's light guides her soul.
  • [CLERIC OF SHAR] I will ask the Lady of Loss to guide her into the night eternal.
  • [CLERIC OF TALOS] I pray she rests in the stormy waves of Talos' embrace.
  • [CLERIC OF TEMPUS] It sounds like she died in battle - I will pray for Tempus to guide her soul.
  • [CLERIC OF TIAMAT] Tiamat's unholy flame - may its light guide her in death.
  • [CLERIC OF TYMORA] Tymora's luck - may your fallen carry it into the afterlife.
  • [CLERIC OF TYR] Lord Tyr will intercede for your dead.
  • [CLERIC OF VLAAKITH] Your pathetic dead will bask in the glory of Vlaakith's prayer.
  • [CLERIC OF YONDALLA] An intercession from the Lady of Plenty.
  • [MONK] I wish her soul the stillness of a calmed ocean.
  • [BARBARIAN] ROAR.

Offering a tribute grants the ⁠Sea Memorial to party members with the  Entertainer background. The party may then ask for more information on Holli's death, and can offer to help find the beast who killed her, or the party can say that the matter has already been taken care of.

Entering Allandra's room upstairs causes her and her priestesses to become hostile.

Idle banter

Allandra is holding a ceremony for  Holli Dylford:

  • Allandra Grey
    Sing, sisters! Sing in Umberlee's name!
  • Allandra Grey
    Glorious Wavemother, pour fury upon the beast responsible for this injustice!
  • Allandra Grey
    Furious and merciful Umberlee, hear our prayer!
  • Allandra Grey
    Praise her for this most holy death!
  • Allandra Grey
    Leave its master a bloated carcass in the spume!
  • Allandra Grey
    Rejoice as the Wavemother welcomes another daughter to the Deep Wilds!
  • Allandra Grey
    Know that we too shall gladly follow when our time has come!
  • Allandra Grey
    Flood the world with your word! Subsume us utterly!

Notes

  • Allandra's title, Flood Tide, is equivalent to High Priestess.
  • Allandra and her priestesses are allied with the Sahuagin, who worship Umberlee, too. The Sahuagin fight with the priestesses against the party when the treasure pile under the temple is disturbed.
  • According to a note in the Sword Coast Couriers address book, couriers must only be sent with Water Breathing potions on hand.
